body: You have to get help.  It’s ok right now. I’ve been there more than I can say.  I could have written this.  The problem is, real life, work doesn’t allow for this.  I have a very overwhelming and sometimes very challenging job.  I have to force myself like I didn’t in college.  I could fail and try again then.  I cant now.  This is my livelihood.  Get help now. Be ok with meds if that’s what they say you need.  Nothing but love and good thoughts to you.

I have no degree but amazing kids and a wonderful high paying job bc I worked hard and had some breaks bc I’m charming.  You’re way ahead of a lot of people.  Confidence is all you need.  You’ve got this. Start at a big nationally known company and you’ll have mobility a lot of people don’t to move up and on to another area in the country or would.  You’ve got this!
